user.title: Add FF Agent service
user.description: Add one service per organization. Find your personal reply link in FF-Agent → Personal profile → Weblinks für Einsatzmeldung. Copy only the UUID between /missionreplies/ and /accept (or /reject), not the complete URL or its parameters. Keep it secret: anyone with this ID can send replies on your behalf. Only explicit reply actions contact FF-Agent. Acceptance sends your Home Assistant home coordinates and selected transport.

data_description.name: For example: Feuerwehr Berglern
data_description.reply_id: UUID only, in xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx format. Stored only in Home Assistant.
data_description.transport: Sent with your Home Assistant home coordinates when you explicitly accept.

reconfigure.title: Edit FF Agent service
reconfigure.description: Change the organization's settings. The webhook remains unchanged. Find your personal UUID in FF-Agent → Personal profile → Weblinks für Einsatzmeldung, between /missionreplies/ and /accept (or /reject). Enter only the UUID, not the complete URL. Saving settings sends nothing. Explicit acceptance sends the selected transport and Home Assistant home coordinates.

webhook.title: Alarm webhook
webhook.description:
Save this service to activate its personal webhook:

`{webhook_url}`

In FF-Agent's Generic webhook form use GET and HTTPS. No body, Basic authentication or additional headers. Reopen this address later using Configure on the service.

Keep the address secret: opening it, including via link previews, triggers an alarm signal. Each GET emits ff_agent_alarm. The alarm sensor stays active for at most four hours; repeated hooks do not extend it. Reply actions are manual. No incident details or dashboard card yet. This does not replace official alarm systems. Check actual event reception, not just HTTP 200.

webhook_local.title: Alarm webhook — local test
webhook_local.description:
Save this service, then open this address in another browser tab to test:

`{webhook_url}`

> [!WARNING]
> Local test address only — do not enter it in FF-Agent. Localhost and private network addresses cannot be reached by FF-Agent. For real delivery, set up public HTTPS access, for example Home Assistant Cloud by Nabu Casa, and configure the external URL under Settings → System → Network. No public access is set up automatically.

Reopen Configure afterwards to get the external address. In FF-Agent use GET and HTTPS, without a body, Basic authentication or additional headers.

Keep the address secret: opening it, including via link previews, triggers an alarm signal. Each GET emits ff_agent_alarm with config_entry_id. The alarm sensor stays active for at most four hours; repeated hooks do not extend it. Reply actions are manual. No incident details or dashboard card yet. Check event reception under Developer tools → Events; HTTP 200 alone is not proof. This does not replace official alarm systems.

error.invalid_reply_id: Enter only a valid hyphenated UUID, not a complete URL.
error.already_configured: This reply ID is already configured in another service.

abort.already_configured: This reply ID was already added in another setup dialog.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The service settings have been updated.

init.title: Alarm webhook
init.description:
This service's secret webhook address:

`{webhook_url}`

FF-Agent Generic webhook: GET and HTTPS. No body, Basic authentication or additional headers. Keep this address private: opening it, including via link previews, triggers an alarm signal.

Each GET emits ff_agent_alarm with config_entry_id. The alarm sensor stays active for at most four hours; repeated hooks do not extend it. Reply actions are manual. No incident details are processed. Listen for ff_agent_alarm under Developer tools → Events; HTTP 200 alone does not prove reception.

To edit the name, reply ID or transport, use Reconfigure in the service's menu.

accept.name: Accept incident
accept.description: Send acceptance for the selected organization using the configured transport and Home Assistant home coordinates, even without an active alarm. This contacts FF-Agent.

reject.name: Reject incident
reject.description: Send rejection for the selected organization, even without an active alarm, and end the local alarm after HTTP delivery. No coordinates or transport are sent. This contacts FF-Agent.

end_alarm.name: End alarm
end_alarm.description: Clear only the selected local alarm. Retains its last reply and sends nothing to FF-Agent.

reply_unconfirmed.message: Reply delivery is unconfirmed. The previous status was retained. Check FF-Agent before trying again; the request may already have been processed.

alarm_changed.message: The local alarm ended or changed while sending. Its reply status was not overwritten. Check FF-Agent before trying again.
